visual_environment.illumination: No direct moonlight; forms are carried by charcoal/graphite value and only the faintest silver edge or reflected virtue-color.
visual_environment.palette: Near-black graphite, paper gray, muted virtue color, almost no silver-white.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Precondition, secrecy, stillness, unlit gate, and potential before the lunar cycle declares itself.
visual_environment.motion: Nearly still; movement is inferred rather than illuminated.
visual_environment.density: Low visible information in the outer field; local colored structure may remain legible.
visual_environment.material_effects: Graphite tooth and erasure dominate; silverpoint appears as buried construction rather than shine.

visual_environment.illumination: A thin directional silver rim catches one side of forms while most of the field remains dark.
visual_environment.palette: Graphite and virtue color with a narrow cool silver-white crescent accent.
visual_environment.atmosphere: First opening, tentative visibility, beginning, and a gate just starting to answer.
visual_environment.motion: Subtle emergence toward the lit edge.
visual_environment.density: Low-to-moderate; detail concentrates where the rim light touches.
visual_environment.material_effects: Silverpoint and rubbed white pigment skim raised edges without changing the underlying family medium.

visual_environment.illumination: Half the scene is clearly silver-lit and half held in graphite shadow, with a firm terminator line or split plane.
visual_environment.palette: Equal charcoal and silver-white modulation over the virtue's authored color.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Decision, tension, half-open gate, and two equally real conditions held at once.
visual_environment.motion: Balanced directional pull across the light/shadow divide.
visual_environment.material_effects: One side reveals paper/color texture; the other compresses toward graphite mass.

visual_environment.illumination: Broad cool silver illumination fills most forms, leaving a smaller but still meaningful dark remainder.
visual_environment.palette: Virtue color lifted by abundant silver-white with charcoal retained at the retreating edge.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Near-readiness, swelling visibility, anticipation, and an opening almost complete.
visual_environment.motion: Light appears to advance or gather toward fullness.
visual_environment.density: Moderate-to-high visible detail as more of the field becomes readable.
visual_environment.material_effects: Translucent color glazes brighten; silver rubbing and graphite hatching coexist rather than flatten.

visual_environment.illumination: Maximum cool silver-white lunar fill with soft reflected light and minimal hidden form.
visual_environment.palette: Virtue color at its clearest under luminous silver-white; graphite remains structural rather than dominant.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Disclosure, fullness, wide-open gate, clarity, and exposure without necessarily implying moral goodness.
visual_environment.density: Highest legible detail across the whole field.
visual_environment.material_effects: Silverpoint, pale pigment, reflective mineral fleck, and paper highlights become fully active.

visual_environment.illumination: Still-bright silver light comes from the receding side, with longer graphite shadows beginning to reclaim the frame.
visual_environment.palette: Cool silver and virtue color remain rich but begin to deepen toward graphite at one edge.
visual_environment.atmosphere: After-peak reflection, consequence, gratitude or fatigue, and light beginning to withdraw.
visual_environment.motion: A slow ebb away from maximum disclosure.
visual_environment.density: High but slightly less even; detail begins to fall off at the darkening edge.
visual_environment.material_effects: Silver glaze thins visibly into graphite hatch, making recession part of the material surface.

visual_environment.illumination: Half-light returns in the opposite orientation from first quarter: one side relinquished to shadow, the other still clearly silver-lit.
visual_environment.palette: Cool half-silver / half-graphite modulation over the virtue color, with the shadow side now dominant in emotional direction.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Release, reckoning, half-closing gate, and the decision of what to carry into darkness.
visual_environment.motion: Directional withdrawal toward the unlit half.
visual_environment.density: Moderate and partitioned, with disappearing detail emphasized.
visual_environment.material_effects: Erasure and dark graphite re-enter visibly; remaining silver edges feel like residue rather than emergence.

visual_environment.illumination: Only a last thin silver sliver remains, grazing the edge of a field already mostly returned to graphite dark.
visual_environment.palette: Near-black/gray with the virtue color subdued and one fading cool silver accent.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Closure, last memory, relinquishment, final gate before dark, and quiet return to precondition.
visual_environment.motion: Fading, settling, descending, or turning inward.
visual_environment.density: Low; the scene sheds visible detail toward the next new moon.
visual_environment.material_effects: Graphite and paper regain dominance while silverpoint survives as a hairline trace or rubbed ghost.
